clips.title: The story
paras: Executor Arren sends you after a courier bound for the camp outside Deathknell. Dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery, the courier carries word from the crusade to its camp. Intercepting him secures intelligence before the zealots can strengthen their hold in the valley. This is among the Forsaken's first offensive efforts to secure their fledgling sanctuary.

Word of the Scarlet courier reaches Executor Arren through his superiors in Brill. The Scarlet Crusade sent an emissary west from its stronghold at the Scarlet Monastery to Deathknell. Crusaders press across Lordaeron, and a courier sent to the edge of the Forsaken's waking grounds signals an organized effort to destroy the newly risen before they can prepare a defense.

Meven Korgal, the courier, blended into the small Scarlet camp east of Deathknell without distinctive heraldry. Executor Arren orders a targeted strike to kill Korgal and seize his dispatch. Taking the missives cuts off the local zealots from further tactical coordination with their eastern headquarters.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Reports from my superiors in Brill indicate that an agent of the Scarlet Crusade was dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery and sent here to Deathknell. According to the reports, the messenger possesses important information on his person. I do not have further details, but whatever it is, we must have it!
You're the most qualified person I have to send, friend. Find that messenger and bring me whatever information you can find.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm... Let's see what you've got...

Some news of their exploits against us... Worthless. Scouting reports... New orders, "Continue to build up a camp near the ruined city..." Nothing we didn't know already... Ah, what's this? A map of the dispositions of some of their field commanders and agents! We can use this.
